title: Authority Grant Change
description: A proposal to grant a caller authority for a capability, or to revoke the active grant, and its resolution (RFC-0023 phase 3). One person proposes it; a different person approves or rejects it with a step up authorization; neither may be the caller the grant is for.

changeId.description: Unique id of the change, a UUID. The step up authorization for approve or reject names it in payload.pendingPolicyChangeId. An approved grant change's id is also the grantId.

limits.description: grant only, optional. Limits on the request, by Intent path: target or parameters.<name>. min and max (inclusive) apply to a number there; oneOf lists the only values allowed there. A request whose value is missing, of another type, or outside a limit is NOT_AUTHORIZED.

validFrom.description: grant only, optional. Without it the grant starts when it is approved.

validUntil.description: grant only, required. At most 366 days after validFrom (or the proposal).

proposedBy.description: The proposer's caller id. Always a human credential, never the grantee.

resolvedBy.description: Who approved or rejected it. Never the proposer or the grantee.

examples.reason: The warehouse agent releases goods for paid invoices up to 100000 INR this quarter.
